title: Dana NextGen Funding Opportunities for Neuroscience and Society
content:
Dana NextGen recently announced two funding opportunities for students/trainees interested in neuroscience and society, and we wanted to reach out to share the details with IYNA community members. 

Professional Development Awards

Undergraduate, postbaccalaureate, graduate, and post-doctoral trainees at U.S.-based institutions may request up to $5,000 USD in funding to support professional development in neuroscience and society. The funds could be used to support the following (note that these are examples and not an exhaustive list):
Attending a conference or workshop in neuroscience and society.
Neuroscience and society coursework.

title: NeuroNexus 2024 Research Symposium
content:
NeuroNexus is a research symposium organized by Youth Neuroscience Association of Nigeria In collaboration with Brain Wellness Initiative, aimed at recognizing university students based on their research insights and outputs in the field of Neuroscience. Submit your innovative research proposals, reviews, and summarized research article findings for NeuroNexus from July 19 to September 4, 2024.

Eligibility: Undergraduate students worldwide 

Selection Process:
a). Test for originality and strict adherence to guidelines 
b). Double blind peer review process.

The final presentation and award ceremony is scheduled for September 14 (Zoom).

title: Purple Ambassadors (Alzheimer's Association)
content:
HEY IYNA!

Are you passionate about Alzheimer's and other dementia? Would you like an opportunity to explore different aspects of neuroscience, such as advocacy/policy work and educational content creation? 

The Purple Ambassadors, under the Alzheimer's Association, is a team of high school and college students dedicated to increasing youth engagement with the Association's work. We work proactively for underserved communities and collaborate with several student-led groups in order to improve the quality of life for those with dementia. 

Our highlights include advocating at the WA State Capitol annually and generating $500k in funds at the Assocation's annual gala!

content:

title: The Neuro-School 2025 Application
content:
Application for The NextGen Neuro-School is now OPEN!

One-Week Virtual Intensive Program for high school & undergraduate students interested in neuroscience! Learn foundational concepts from speakers & TAs globally.

Details:
For: High school & undergrads worldwide.
Eligibility: Students globally with interest in neuroscience.
Application Deadline: Sept 12th, 2025.
Outcome: Recognized certificate for active participants, virtual networking and mentorship.

title: Sympify: Minimizing misdiagnosis rates with AI
content: Sympify is an organization developing an interactive technology tool, aiming to assist individuals in navigating health issues and misdiagnoses. You can find more information about our goals, our current achievements, and our successful prelaunch app party at our Instagram, @sympify.ai. By joining our team, you will have access to research opportunities, be able to lead fundraisers, work with college professors and medical professionals, or contribute directly to the app. We are a PVSA-certified nonprofit organization, so you will receive volunteer hours for your work. This is also a chance for you to build your resume and develop skills in business, technology, or research.

title: Join Us As a Volunteer For NeuroLit!
content:
Are you passionate about making neuroscience accessible and inspiring young minds?

NeuroLit is currently seeking volunteers for a neuroscience literacy project to help us empower the next generation by breaking down complex neuroscience and health concepts into engaging, easy-to-understand experiences for children. Through educational content, workshops, and community outreach, we strive to nurture curious minds that are equipped to explore and understand the world of science. We welcome volunteers from all backgrounds who share our passion for science and education. We track volunteer hours and provide a certificate of recognition at the end!

title: International Robotics Alliance (IRA) - Free research guidance
content:
Hey everyone!

At the International Robotics Alliance (IRA), we’re bringing together high school researchers to tackle real robotics projects in mechanical, AI, aerospace, biomedical, and every branch of engineering!

You can get structured research guidance, work in a team, and publish a paper in our IRA Journal in under 9 weeks completely free. Mentorship from high schoolers who have done it before will keep you on track alongside industry experts.

title: [CALL FOR ESSAY SUBMISSIONS] Discover Your Mind
content:
Introducing 'Discover Your Mind' – an exciting new neuroscience essay competition hosted by Discover Mind! This year’s theme is Pets & Brain Disorders, and we’re inviting everyone to share their unique perspectives on the intersection of neuroscience, veterinary science, and animal welfare.

Who Can Participate?
Everyone! Whether you’re passionate about neuroscience, animals, or simply love writing, this contest is for you. Authors will be grouped by age:
Junior Category: 16 and under
Middle Category: 17 to 25
Senior Category: 26 and above

title: Non-profit community for college prep & scholarships
content:
We're a completely non profit community focused on helping high school students with college preparation!

We collect and organize databases of scholarships, financial aid opportunities, and college lists, share tips for exams and extracurriculars, connect students with mentors and opportunities, and help them learn about programs, clubs, competitions, and admissions.

We'd love to have you join us, Hope to see you around in the server!
https://discord.gg/jybmYXsPDK

title: 🧠 Join the Synapse Session!
content:
🧠 Want to explore neuroscience and connect with experts around the globe? 

Founded in May 2019, Simply Neuroscience is a student-led organization dedicated to expanding interdisciplinary education, outreach, and awareness about neuroscience. 

We are excited to bring you to the third Synapse Session! 

Event Details
📅 Date: Saturday, September 28
⏰ Time: 11:00 A.M. EDT | 8:00 A.M. PDT

title: STEM2Connect: Connect with STEM professors
content: STEM2Connect is a collaborative student platform connecting students to professors to STEM research and learning opportunities. Our mission is to bridge the gap between students and leading experts in STEM fields. We have reached students all over the world and have connected them to professors from University of San Diego, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and Texas A&M University, with much more to come. Additionally, we offer a wide variety of opportunities to present your own personal research to a wide audience of like-minded students through journals, webinars, etc.

title: Up Next Scientists Visual Lab Quest
content:
HEY SCIENTISTS!!
Up Next Scientists, a 501(c)(3) has some exciting news for you: Our Visual Research Department is excited to announce our first ever research competition, the Visual Lab Quest!
Through this 5-week virtual program held every Sunday at 10:00-10:40 AM PST from November 17-December 15, participants will learn how to research about a lab experiment in a STEAM subject of their choice, how to aesthetically showcase their findings on a research presentation, and how to confidently speak about the project to a panel of judges.

title: Deductra: Making healthcare costs & insurance easy to understand
content:
👋 Welcome to Deductra!

Most people don't learn how health insurance works until they receive a confusing medical bill.

Deductra is a student-led initiative focused on making healthcare costs and insurance easier to understand through education, technology, research, and community-driven solutions.

🎯 Our Mission
Help people understand:
• Deductibles
• Copays
• Coinsurance
• Out-of-pocket maximums
• Medical bills
• Healthcare pricing
• Healthcare transparency

title: MediSec Fellowship Applications Are Officially Open
content:
🚨 MediSec Fellowship Applications Are Officially Open 🚨

The future of healthcare depends on security, innovation, and the next generation of leaders willing to make a difference.

At MediSec, students don’t just learn about cybersecurity and healthcare — they actively work on projects that spread awareness, strengthen communities, and explore real-world challenges at the intersection of medicine and technology.

title: Eunoia Global Health
content:
Hello there! 

We are Eunoia Global Health, a group of youth excited about educating the public on global health issues. If you are passionate about closing the knowledge gap preventing people from accessing free, well-researched information, then join our platform and use your voice for change! Eunoia's mission is to foster creativity and provide students a place to express their voices. Help us create a difference in the global health world by volunteering with us!

title: Cortex: Connecting students with medicine-focused initiatives
content:
Hello everyone!

We're Cortex, a student-centered organization dedicated to connecting aspiring healthcare professionals & interested students with medicine-focused initiatives & organizations.

By providing our students with accessible resources, we want to simplify the search for students seeking meaningful opportunities in the medical field. We hope to bridge the gap between academic aspirations and real world experiences, fostering and linking together a huge community of those passionate about medicine.

With that said: If you’re a MEMBER or LEADER of a student-led medicine initiative or organization and would like to be FEATURED on our growing initiative catalog – connecting interested students to YOUR organizations – please fill out a quick form or send us an email at cortex2025@gmail.com.

title: Sights on Medicine (SOM)
content:
Hello everyone!

We are Sights on Medicine (SOM), a student-run project that aims to connect the prospective future of medicine with valuable opportunities, experiences, and resources to map out a successful high school/ pre-med career, to create a more inclusive setting across the US and beyond. 

Run by high-school students, we understand the difficulty of finding programs to boost your resume and your pre-med experience, especially in regards to students who are FGLI, or under-resourced. Sights on Med serves students like YOU by doing the heavy-lifting of scouring around, connecting you to opportunities aligning to your medical interests.

title: Vipraa Education: Student-run global network for finance
content:
Vipraa Education is a student-run global network making finance, economics, business, and policy actually engaging for younger students through interactive simulations and real-world activities.

We’re scaling fast—and looking for driven students to lead that growth.

This is not resume padding.

This is:
• Founding and leading your own chapter
• Running real events in your school or community
• Building partnerships with schools, libraries, and nonprofits
• Creating measurable impact in financial literacy
